name: City of Peekskill
gaps: Peekskill sets bulk rules in section text (§§ 575-22 to 575-28, 575-43), not an attachment schedule; first drafted from the Zoneomics copy, then checked against eCode360
R-1 districts: the 2.5-story cap applies only to buildings other than one-family dwellings, so max_stories is null; no minimum frontage; no FAR or impervious limit in R-1A/B/C, R-2, R-3
R-2 and R-3 have no own bulk figures: all uses follow the R-1B requirements (§§ 575-23E, 575-24E); two-family (R-2, R-3) needs 7,500 sf / 75 ft and three-family (R-3) 10,000 sf / 100 ft
R-4, R-5, R-6 lot area is per dwelling unit; R-5/R-6 side yards depend on wall height (half the facing wall height, min 12 ft), recorded as the 12 ft minimum; R-6 front/rear grow with height
PRD (§ 575-28) and W - F PRD (§ 575-43F): no height or coverage figure found for one-family lots in PRD; W - F PRD one-family uses follow R-1B, district height cap 3 stories / 38 ft

Accessory building height limit not found; no local wetlands law beyond Ch. 294 (state wetlands + 100 ft adjacent area); watercourse buffer not set; accessory apartment and pool rules not found; tree-permit size threshold (6 in. DBH) from a search summary, clear-cutting thresholds read in Ch. 530

wetlands.summary: Ch. 294: the City exercises NYS DEC Freshwater Wetlands Act authority over state-mapped wetlands and the adjacent area up to 100 ft from their boundary; no separate local wetland or watercourse buffer.

steep_slopes.summary: Ch. 488: regulates slopes of 15%+ over at least 100 sf (15-25% moderately steep, 25-35% very steep, 35%+ extremely steep); the steepest class sets the approval authority.

trees.summary: Ch. 530 Tree Preservation: permit to remove trees of 6 in. DBH or more on private property; clear-cutting = 6+ trees (lots <= 7,500 sf) or 10+ trees (larger lots) of 6 in.+ DBH.

stormwater.summary: Ch. 492: SWPPP and Stormwater Management Officer review for land development activities as defined in the chapter.

general.accessory_structures: Accessory buildings at least 10 ft from any property line in R-1A and 6 ft in R-1B/R-1C (on corner lots, from one side lot line) (§ 575-22D(4)).
general.notes: Local Waterfront Revitalization Program consistency review (Ch. 365) applies within the LWRP boundary (§ 575-19).

R - 1A.name: One-Family Residence R-1A

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings not nearer than 10 ft to any property line (to one side lot line on corner lots) (§ 575-22D(4))

R - 1A.notes: Front yard 25 ft (wall planes meeting the street line at 25 deg or more may come to 20 ft). Height 35 ft; the 2.5-story cap applies to buildings other than one-family dwellings. Corner lots have two front yards, two side yards and no rear yard (§ 575-22D(2)). Side yards 10 ft each; a dwelling without a garage needs one side yard of 22 ft; walls at 25 deg or more to the side line may come to 8 ft. Corner lots: one side yard 30 ft, the other 10 ft (22 ft without a garage). Lot depth 100 ft (90 ft if average depth is 100 ft).

R - 1B.name: One-Family Residence R-1B

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings not nearer than 6 ft to any property line (to one side lot line on corner lots) (§ 575-22D(4))

R - 1B.notes: Front yard 25 ft (wall planes meeting the street line at 25 deg or more may come to 20 ft). Height 35 ft; the 2.5-story cap applies to buildings other than one-family dwellings. Corner lots have two front yards, two side yards and no rear yard (§ 575-22D(2)). Side yards 6 ft each, 15 ft combined; a dwelling without a garage needs one side yard of 18 ft. Lot depth 100 ft (90 ft if average depth is 100 ft).

R - 1C.name: One-Family Residence R-1C

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings not nearer than 6 ft to any property line (to one side lot line on corner lots) (§ 575-22D(4))

R - 1C.notes: Front yard 25 ft (wall planes meeting the street line at 25 deg or more may come to 20 ft). Height 35 ft; the 2.5-story cap applies to buildings other than one-family dwellings. Corner lots have two front yards, two side yards and no rear yard (§ 575-22D(2)). Side yards 6 ft each, 15 ft combined; a dwelling without a garage needs one side yard of 18 ft. Lot depth 100 ft (90 ft if average depth is 100 ft).

R - 2.name: One- and Two-Family Residence R-2

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings not nearer than 6 ft to any property line (to one side lot line on corner lots) (§ 575-22D(4))

R - 2.notes: Front yard 25 ft (wall planes meeting the street line at 25 deg or more may come to 20 ft). Height 35 ft; the 2.5-story cap applies to buildings other than one-family dwellings. Corner lots have two front yards, two side yards and no rear yard (§ 575-22D(2)). All uses follow the R-1B requirements (§ 575-23E). Side yards 6 ft each, 15 ft combined; a dwelling without a garage needs one side yard of 18 ft. Lot depth 100 ft (90 ft if average depth is 100 ft). Two-family dwellings by Planning Commission special permit: 7,500 sf lot, 75 ft width, 4 parking spaces.

R - 3.name: One-, Two- and Three-Family Residence R-3

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings not nearer than 6 ft to any property line (to one side lot line on corner lots) (§ 575-22D(4))

R - 3.notes: Front yard 25 ft (wall planes meeting the street line at 25 deg or more may come to 20 ft). Height 35 ft; the 2.5-story cap applies to buildings other than one-family dwellings. Corner lots have two front yards, two side yards and no rear yard (§ 575-22D(2)). All uses follow the R-1B requirements (§ 575-24E). Side yards 6 ft each, 15 ft combined; a dwelling without a garage needs one side yard of 18 ft. Lot depth 100 ft (90 ft if average depth is 100 ft). Three-family by special permit: 10,000 sf lot, 100 ft width, 6 parking spaces; two-family as in R-2.

R - 4.name: Low-Density Multiple Residence R-4

max_building_coverage.note: All principal and accessory buildings; ZBA may allow 5% more for accessory garages

R - 4.notes: 5,000 sf of land per dwelling unit; average lot depth 100 ft; front 30 ft (25 ft with 25 deg wall planes); 400 sf usable open space per unit; townhouses on parcels of 10,000 sf+, max 8 per acre. One-family dwellings permitted (R-1A uses). 2.5-story cap for non-one-family buildings.

R - 5.name: Medium-Density Multiple Residence R-5

max_building_coverage.note: All principal and accessory buildings (R-4 rule via § 575-26E)

R - 5.notes: Land per dwelling unit: 4,000 sf on parcels over 5 acres, 6,000 sf on smaller parcels. Side yard half the facing wall height, min 12 ft. 3.5-story cap for non-one-family buildings. One-family dwellings permitted (R-4 uses).

R - 6.name: Central Multiple Residence R-6

max_building_coverage.note: All principal and accessory buildings; +5% for garages by ZBA, +10% if 80% of units are in buildings of 4 stories or less

R - 6.notes: 20,000 sf development parcel and 2,000 sf of land per unit; front 25 ft or 1/3 of wall height; side half the facing wall height (min 12 ft) up to 36 ft tall, 25 ft + 1/4 height above; rear 30 ft or 1/3 height; 400 sf usable open space per unit. One-family dwellings permitted (R-4 uses).

PRD.name: Planned Residential Development
PRD.notes: One-family dwellings (one per lot) or clustered development (§ 575-29, max 9 units per net acre, 50 ft+ perimeter setbacks). Side yard 22 ft on one side without a garage; corner lots 30 ft and 10 ft. Accessory uses as in R-1A.

W - F PRD.name: Waterfront District, WF-PRD subarea

accessory.notes: Accessory buildings not nearer than 6 ft to any property line (to one side lot line on corner lots) (§ 575-22D(4))

W - F PRD.notes: One-family uses as regulated in R-1B (values shown are R-1B). Attached/garden/mid-rise housing and hotels by Common Council special permit; WF-PRD height max 3 stories / 38 ft (to 52 ft near the convent building); max 9 units per acre (11 with bonuses); avoid development on 20%+ slopes.
